research_rationale: All original and prior actor-context texts are identical to the earlier packet; alternate own-term extractions do not add an occurrence fact. EO13040 replaces section 3 report deadlines and partially changes section 1(a) membership; EO13056 again changes membership only. Neither changes section 5: termination occurs 30 days after actual final-report submission, no later than two years after September 5, 1996 unless extended. The March 30, 1998 deadline is not proof of receipt/submission, and the September 5, 1998 outside limit cannot be called first cessation while the earlier report trigger is undated. EO13138 section 3(a) formally revokes the amended order effective September 30, 1999 and describes an already terminated committee, but supplies no trigger date. No independent surviving committee command or express savings appears.
unresolved_material_gaps: Actual final-report submission date remains absent; establish and apply section 5’s 30-day trigger before choosing the two-year outside limit or the later formal revocation.
